sections.heading: Is there a verified completion time?

blocks.text: The official sources linked here do not establish a universal first-run, all-endings or completionist time. We have withdrawn the previous fixed hour estimates and episode timetable. Reading pace, exploration and replay goals differ between players.

Record the platform, game version, play style and actual time spent. Separate active play from pauses and menu time. Use your completed sessions as a personal estimate rather than treating another player’s total as a guarantee.

Explorer allows Turning Points during the story. Survivor disables this rewind feature during the first story and unlocks it after reaching an ending. This changes when you can revisit decisions; it does not establish a fixed number of extra hours.

sections.heading: Play style and difficulty are separate

blocks.text: Explorer and Survivor are play styles. Forgiving, Challenging, Lethal and Custom control difficulty. Reading settings, exploration and group discussion may affect session length, but no setting guarantees a shorter run.

Finishing the story, exploring alternate branches and completing platform achievements are different goals. Do not calculate completion time from an unverified collectible count or assume one route unlocks every outcome.
